schema: CREATE TABLE approval_bindings(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approval' CHECK(kind='approval'), action_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(action_digest)=64 AND action_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,request_id), UNIQUE(principal_id,request_id,action_digest), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,request_id,kind) REFERENCES record_heads(principal_id,id,kind)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE audit(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id), command_id TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,command_id) REFERENCES commands(principal_id,command_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED) STRICT

CREATE TABLE commands(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id), command_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(digest)=64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), receipt TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(receipt)), PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,command_id)) STRICT
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_record_update BEFORE UPDATE ON record_heads WHEN OLD.kind IN ('brief','contract','artifact','evidence') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable record'); END

CREATE TABLE intent_approval_bindings(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, intent_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'intent' CHECK(kind='intent'), request_id TEXT NOT NULL, action_digest TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,intent_id), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,intent_id,kind) REFERENCES record_heads(principal_id,id,kind), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,request_id,action_digest) REFERENCES approval_bindings(principal_id,request_id,action_digest)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE memberships(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id), actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('owner','viewer','revoked')), generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,actor_id)) STRICT
CREATE TABLE meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

CREATE TABLE native_attempts(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'attempt' CHECK(attempt_kind='attempt'), run_id TEXT NOT NULL, run_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'run' CHECK(run_kind='run'), scope_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_epoch TEXT NOT NULL, binding TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(binding)), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('prepared','send_intent','running','completed','interrupted','failed','unknown','discarded')), cancellation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(cancellation IN ('not_requested','requested','observed')), thread_id TEXT, turn_id TEXT, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,id), UNIQUE(principal_id,run_id), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,id,attempt_kind) REFERENCES record_heads(principal_id,id,kind), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,run_id,run_kind) REFERENCES record_heads(principal_id,id,kind), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,scope_id) REFERENCES scopes(principal_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,actor_id) REFERENCES memberships(principal_id,actor_id), CHECK(turn_id IS NULL OR thread_id IS NOT NULL)) STRICT
CREATE TRIGGER native_event_delete BEFORE DELETE ON native_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native event cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE TRIGGER native_event_update BEFORE UPDATE ON native_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native event is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE native_events(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL,id TEXT NOT NULL,attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,event_key TEXT NOT NULL,digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(digest)=64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(payload)),PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,id),UNIQUE(principal_id,attempt_id,event_key,digest),FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,attempt_id) REFERENCES native_attempts(principal_id,id)) STRICT

CREATE TRIGGER native_identity_update BEFORE UPDATE ON native_attempts WHEN NEW.principal_id!=OLD.principal_id OR NEW.id!=OLD.id OR NEW.run_id!=OLD.run_id OR NEW.scope_id!=OLD.scope_id OR NEW.actor_id!=OLD.actor_id OR NEW.owner_id!=OLD.owner_id OR NEW.owner_epoch!=OLD.owner_epoch OR NEW.binding!=OLD.binding OR (OLD.thread_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.thread_id IS NOT OLD.thread_id) OR (OLD.turn_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.turn_id IS NOT OLD.turn_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native identity is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER native_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON native_attempts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'native attempt cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX native_one_active_scope ON native_attempts(principal_id,scope_id) WHERE state IN ('prepared','send_intent','running')
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX native_turn_identity ON native_attempts(principal_id,json_extract(binding,'$.accountRoute'),thread_id,turn_id) WHERE turn_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_application_scope ON scopes(kind) WHERE kind='application'
CREATE TABLE principals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('person','organization')), display_name TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

CREATE TABLE record_heads(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, current_version_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,id), UNIQUE(principal_id,id,kind), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,kind,id,revision,current_version_id) REFERENCES record_versions(principal_id,kind,subject_id,revision,version_id)) STRICT

CREATE TRIGGER record_identity_update BEFORE UPDATE ON record_heads WHEN NEW.principal_id!=OLD.principal_id OR NEW.id!=OLD.id OR NEW.kind!=OLD.kind BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'record identity is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER record_version_delete BEFORE DELETE ON record_versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'record version cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE TRIGGER record_version_update BEFORE UPDATE ON record_versions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'record version is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE record_versions(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id), version_id TEXT NOT NULL, subject_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('conversation','message','brief','contract','policy','mission','approval','intent','artifact','outcome','evidence','control_operation','dispatch_observation','cost_obligation','run','attempt','reconciliation_case','cost_event','job','knowledge','evaluation','knowledge_use','source','source_grant','context_manifest','change','classification_correction','resource_snapshot','resource_hold','budget_month')), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), data TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(data)), PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,version_id), UNIQUE(principal_id,kind,subject_id,revision), UNIQUE(principal_id,kind,subject_id,revision,version_id)) STRICT
CREATE TRIGGER runner_lease_delete BEFORE DELETE ON runner_leases BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'lease history cannot be deleted'); END

CREATE TRIGGER runner_lease_insert BEFORE INSERT ON runner_leases WHEN NEW.state!='active' OR NEW.revision!=1 OR NEW.sequence!=0 OR NEW.dispatched!=0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runner_workspaces w WHERE w.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND w.id=NEW.workspace_id AND w.generation=NEW.generation AND w.state='ready') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'new lease workspace/state mismatch'); END

CREATE TRIGGER runner_lease_release BEFORE UPDATE ON runner_leases WHEN NEW.state='released' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runner_stop_observations o JOIN runner_workspaces w ON w.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND w.id=NEW.workspace_id JOIN runner_profiles p ON p.principal_id=w.principal_id AND p.id=w.profile_id AND p.revision=w.profile_revision WHERE o.principal_id=NEW.principal_id AND o.id=NEW.observation_id AND o.lease_id=NEW.id AND o.workspace_id=NEW.workspace_id AND o.generation=NEW.generation AND o.owner_id=NEW.owner_id AND o.owner_epoch=NEW.owner_epoch AND o.stop_epoch=NEW.stop_epoch AND o.kind=p.kind AND o.handles_signaled=1 AND o.job_empty=1 AND o.writes_stable=1) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'matching complete stop observation required'); END

CREATE TRIGGER runner_lease_update BEFORE UPDATE ON runner_leases WHEN NEW.principal_id!=OLD.principal_id OR NEW.id!=OLD.id OR NEW.workspace_id!=OLD.workspace_id OR NEW.generation!=OLD.generation OR NEW.scope_id!=OLD.scope_id OR NEW.actor_id!=OLD.actor_id OR NEW.owner_id!=OLD.owner_id OR NEW.owner_epoch!=OLD.owner_epoch OR NEW.operation!=OLD.operation OR NEW.hard_deadline!=OLD.hard_deadline OR NEW.revision!=OLD.revision+1 OR NEW.sequence<OLD.sequence OR NEW.stop_epoch<OLD.stop_epoch OR NEW.dispatched<OLD.dispatched OR NEW.updated_at<OLD.updated_at OR OLD.state='released' OR (OLD.state!='active' AND NEW.state='active') OR (OLD.state!='active' AND NEW.expires_at!=OLD.expires_at) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'lease identity/state/revision mismatch'); END

CREATE TABLE runner_leases(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), scope_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(owner_epoch BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), stop_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stop_epoch IN (0,1)), operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation='verify'), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','stop_requested','quarantined','released')), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999999999999), expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(expires_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), hard_deadline INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(hard_deadline BETWEEN expires_at AND 9007199254740991), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(updated_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), dispatched INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(dispatched IN (0,1)), observation_id TEXT, CHECK((state='active' AND stop_epoch=0 AND observation_id IS NULL) OR (state IN ('stop_requested','quarantined') AND stop_epoch=1 AND observation_id IS NULL) OR (state='released' AND observation_id IS NOT NULL)), UNIQUE(principal_id,id,workspace_id,generation,owner_id,owner_epoch,stop_epoch), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,workspace_id) REFERENCES runner_workspaces(principal_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,scope_id) REFERENCES scopes(principal_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,actor_id) REFERENCES memberships(principal_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,observation_id) REFERENCES runner_stop_observations(principal_id,id)) STRICT
CREATE TRIGGER runner_observation_delete BEFORE DELETE ON runner_stop_observations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'stop observation is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER runner_observation_update BEFORE UPDATE ON runner_stop_observations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'stop observation is immutable'); END
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runner_one_unreleased_writer ON runner_leases(workspace_id) WHERE state!='released'
CREATE TRIGGER runner_profile_delete BEFORE DELETE ON runner_profiles BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'runner profile is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER runner_profile_update BEFORE UPDATE ON runner_profiles BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'runner profile is immutable'); END

CREATE TABLE runner_profiles(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(digest)=64 AND digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('synthetic','fixed_guest_fixture')), isolation_id TEXT NOT NULL, ttl_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ttl_ms BETWEEN 100 AND 60000), PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,id,revision), UNIQUE(principal_id,id,revision,digest,isolation_id)) STRICT

CREATE TABLE runner_stop_observations(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, lease_id TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, stop_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(stop_epoch IN (0,1)), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('synthetic','fixed_guest_fixture')), handles_signaled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(handles_signaled IN (0,1)), job_empty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(job_empty IN (0,1)), writes_stable INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(writes_stable IN (0,1)), observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(observed_at BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), detail TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(detail) AND length(CAST(detail AS BLOB))<=65536), PRIMARY KEY(principal_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,lease_id,workspace_id,generation,owner_id,owner_epoch,stop_epoch) REFERENCES runner_leases(principal_id,id,workspace_id,generation,owner_id,owner_epoch,stop_epoch)) STRICT

CREATE TRIGGER runner_workspace_reuse BEFORE UPDATE ON runner_workspaces WHEN (NEW.generation!=OLD.generation OR NEW.state='ready') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runner_leases l WHERE l.workspace_id=OLD.id AND l.state!='released') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'unreleased writer blocks workspace reuse'); END

CREATE TRIGGER runner_workspace_update BEFORE UPDATE ON runner_workspaces WHEN NEW.principal_id!=OLD.principal_id OR NEW.id!=OLD.id OR NEW.profile_id!=OLD.profile_id OR NEW.profile_revision!=OLD.profile_revision OR NEW.profile_digest!=OLD.profile_digest OR NEW.snapshot_digest!=OLD.snapshot_digest OR NEW.write_set_digest!=OLD.write_set_digest OR NEW.isolation_id!=OLD.isolation_id OR NEW.generation<OLD.generation OR NEW.generation>OLD.generation+1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'workspace binding/generation mismatch'); END

CREATE TABLE runner_workspaces(principal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES principals(id), id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, profile_id TEXT NOT NULL, profile_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, profile_digest TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(snapshot_digest)=64 AND snapshot_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), write_set_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(write_set_digest)=64 AND write_set_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'), isolation_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ready','quarantined')), UNIQUE(principal_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(principal_id,profile_id,profile_revision,profile_digest,isolation_id) REFERENCES runner_profiles(principal_id,id,revision,digest,isolation_id)) STRICT

CREATE TRIGGER scope_identity_update BEFORE UPDATE ON scopes WHEN NEW.id!=OLD.id OR NEW.kind!=OLD.kind OR NEW.principal_id IS NOT OLD.principal_id OR NEW.parent_id IS NOT OLD.parent_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'scope identity is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER scope_parent_insert BEFORE INSERT ON scopes WHEN NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scopes p WHERE p.id=NEW.parent_id AND ((NEW.kind='principal' AND p.kind='application') OR (NEW.kind!='principal' AND p.principal_id=NEW.principal_id))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'scope parent mismatch'); END

CREATE TABLE scopes(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, principal_id TEXT REFERENCES principals(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('application','principal','conversation','mission','control_operation')), parent_id TEXT REFERENCES scopes(id), revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(epoch BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999999999), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','paused','closed')), reason TEXT, actor_id TEXT, changed_at TEXT, CHECK((kind='application' AND principal_id IS NULL AND parent_id IS NULL) OR (kind!='application' AND principal_id IS NOT NULL AND parent_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id!=id), UNIQUE(principal_id,id)) STRICT
